notes: Bali has no public transport: use a scooter (international licence and helmet), Grab/Gojek or a car with a driver by the day (~700,000 IDR). Allow 1-2 hours of traffic between Ubud, Canggu and Uluwatu.
April to October is the dry season, ideal for surfing, Batur and Penida. July and August are crowded and expensive.
Sarongs and sashes are compulsory at temples (provided at the entrance). Do not enter during menstruation, and be respectful on ceremony days.
Babi guling costs 40-60,000 IDR at a warung and nasi campur 30-50,000. Beach club minimum spend is 300-500,000.
Monkeys (Uluwatu, Monkey Forest) snatch glasses and phones. Do not show them food.
Take the morning boat from Sanur for the Nusa Penida tour. The Kelingking descent is difficult, so looking from above is enough.

stops.name: Tegallalang Rice Terrace
stops.tips: Terraced rice fields, quiet and cool at 07:30. The swing is optional, 150,000 IDR.

stops.name: Tirta Empul
stops.tips: A holy spring purification temple. Sarongs are provided, and the pool has 13 fountains.

stops.name: Ubud Palace
stops.tips: The royal palace courtyard, with an evening legong dance (100,000 IDR).

stops.name: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka
stops.tips: The roast pork Bourdain praised, opposite the palace. It sells out by lunchtime.

stops.name: Ubud Monkey Forest
stops.tips: A sacred monkey forest with temples. Watch your glasses and bag.

backups.name: Warung Babi Guling Gung Cung
backups.tips: Local babi guling (roast suckling pig) near the palace.

backups.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk
backups.tips: A 2 km ridge walk, also good for sunset.

stops.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Trek
stops.tips: You are picked up from your hotel at 02:00. Climb for 2 hours, then watch sunrise at 1,717 m and eat eggs cooked in volcanic steam. Tour ~450,000 IDR.

stops.name: Toya Devasya Hot Springs
stops.tips: Hot springs on the shore of Lake Batur, welcome after the trek.

stops.name: Ubud Art Market
stops.tips: A souvenir market. Start bargaining at half the asking price.

stops.name: Warung Biah Biah Ubud
stops.tips: Balinese tapas (small plates), local and affordable.

stops.name: Saraswati Temple
stops.tips: A temple with a lotus pond, next to Starbucks.

backups.name: Tegenungan Waterfall
backups.tips: A waterfall close to Ubud, an alternative to the hot springs.

days.theme: Ubud to Canggu via Tanah Lot

stops.name: Jatiluwih Rice Terraces
stops.tips: UNESCO-listed terraces, wider and calmer than Tegallalang, with walking trails.

stops.name: Ulun Danu Beratan Temple
stops.tips: A temple that appears to float on the lake, with misty mountains behind.

stops.name: Jatiluwih Warung Dhea
stops.tips: Nasi campur (mixed rice plate) with a terrace view.

stops.name: Tanah Lot
stops.tips: A rock temple in the sea. Sunset is the famous moment, and it gets crowded.

stops.name: Canggu Batu Bolong Beach
stops.tips: Canggu's beach bars: beer and surf lights after sunset.

backups.name: Old Man's Canggu
backups.tips: A beach bar, best in the evening.

backups.name: Handara Gate
backups.tips: The Instagram gate, next to the lake temple.

stops.name: Echo Beach Canggu
stops.tips: A surf lesson (~350,000 IDR) or a morning swim. The waves are clean in the dry season.

stops.name: Crate Cafe Canggu
stops.tips: Canggu's brunch culture, with smoothie bowls.

stops.name: Seminyak Village
stops.tips: Boutiques and a mall on Oberoi Street.

stops.name: Babi Guling Pak Malen Seminyak
stops.tips: Seminyak's babi guling (roast suckling pig), with crispy skin.

stops.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset
stops.tips: Ku De Ta or Potato Head beach club (minimum spend), or a beanbag on the sand for sunset.

backups.name: Potato Head Beach Club
backups.tips: A beach club with a pool and DJ.

backups.name: Petitenget Temple
backups.tips: Seminyak's temple, best on ceremony days.

stops.name: Kelingking Beach
stops.tips: 45 minutes by speedboat from Sanur, plus a tour by vehicle (~900,000 IDR). See T-Rex Rock and the view from the top (the descent takes 1 hour and is difficult).

stops.name: Angel's Billabong
stops.tips: A natural pool. Swimming is forbidden at high tide.

stops.name: Broken Beach
stops.tips: A cove with a natural rock arch.

stops.name: Nusa Penida Warung Crystal Bay
stops.tips: A warung at Crystal Bay serving nasi goreng (fried rice).

stops.name: Crystal Bay Snorkelling
stops.tips: See manta rays at Manta Point (boat ~200,000 IDR) or snorkel at Crystal Bay. The boat leaves at 16:00.

backups.name: Diamond Beach
backups.tips: White sand in east Penida, instead of snorkelling.

stops.name: Padang Padang Beach
stops.tips: A small cove reached through the rocks. Quiet in the morning, with monkeys around.

stops.name: Bingin Beach Warung
stops.tips: Grilled fish at the cliffside warungs, reached by stairs.

stops.name: Single Fin Uluwatu
stops.tips: A cliff bar: watch the surf and have lunch.

stops.name: Uluwatu Temple
stops.tips: A sea temple on the cliff. Monkeys snatch glasses, and a sarong is included in the entry fee.

stops.name: Kecak Fire Dance Uluwatu
stops.tips: A kecak dance with 100 performers at sunset. Buy your ticket at 17:00 and sit near the front.

backups.name: Suluban Beach
backups.tips: A surf beach reached through a cave, instead of Padang Padang.

backups.name: Jimbaran Bay Seafood Grill
backups.tips: Grilled seafood on the sand, on the way back from Uluwatu.

stops.name: Sanur Beach Promenade
stops.tips: A 5 km seafront path, with sunrise on Bali's east coast and calm water.

stops.name: Sindhu Market Sanur
stops.tips: A morning market for bubur (rice porridge) and coffee.

stops.name: Sanur Village Spa
stops.tips: A Balinese massage to say goodbye.

stops.name: Warung Mak Beng Sanur
stops.tips: Fried fish and soup since 1941, with a single set menu.

stops.name: Ngurah Rai Airport Transfer
stops.tips: The airport is 30 minutes away.

backups.name: Genius Cafe Sanur
backups.tips: A beachfront cafe for a light bite.

backups.name: Le Mayeur Museum Sanur
backups.tips: The home of the Belgian painter, instead of the spa.
